decisions: Actual Popover portal positioning, collision handling and defaults remain primitive-owned; CSS does not recreate anchor coordinates. Native radius/insets are adopted as semantic popup metrics, while width is fluid with an explicit bounded maximum. Popover keeps native 10px corners/10px insets and the actual 288px source width maximum. Header gap is 2px with native 14/20 typography; Title/Description relations are explicitly supplied in the reference usage. The primitive owns opening, Escape, outside press, focus restoration and controlled callbacks.

Semantic token scalar values are meaningful reusable metrics, never coordinate-keyed specimen dimensions. Widths in native specimen grids remain evidence unless explicitly adopted as a domain layout constraint.
